why_it_is_false: Jared Golden was ME-02's incumbent and was not a candidate. He announced on 2025-11-05 that he would not seek re-election. The Maine Secretary of State's 2026 General Candidate List - FINAL prints exactly two names for Congressional District 2 (Dunlap, Matthew G. and LePage, Paul R.) and names Golden nowhere in its 456 rows. AP's own capture names Golden as the race's incumbent, AP candidate id 66383, and that id appears on none of the four ballot lines AP publishes for the race.
what_is_NOT_wrong: Golden still holds the seat. His office_terms row (term_start 2019-01-03, open-ended, sourced from unitedstates/congress-legislators via migration 1536) is correct and CC_0452 does not touch it. A retiring incumbent holds the office until the term ends on 2027-01-03, exactly as a defeated one does.
